topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I stand there, the world suddenly tilting. We're supposed to be the unbreakable pair, connected by bonds of shared history and secret silences. But now, his eyes are distant, scanning my face as if grappling with a puzzle. "I mean, we met, right? But I don’t recall much," he says, the edges of his smile too eager, too forced. My hands clench into fists at my sides, hidden by the casual fall of my jacket. The knot in my stomach tightens, a silent scream trapped in my throat. How could he forget? We were everything to each other. I nod, forcing a laugh, but inside, everything feels off, the ground beneath me unsteady.
